candidates.change_summary: Replace the guard that prevents re-setting MinSum when initialized to allow SetMinSum to always set MinSum.
Invert the initialized check so SetMinSum only sets MinSum when already initialized (opposite behavior).
Change the assignment to add the provided value to MinSum instead of setting it outright.
Change to assign MinSum to zero unconditionally (observable difference after call).
Replace the revert guard so SetMinSum allows multiple calls by removing the initialized check and always sets MinSum to _val.
Invert the initialized check so SetMinSum only sets MinSum after initialization (i.e., requires intitalized to be true).
Change assignment to add the provided value to MinSum instead of replacing it.
Set MinSum to zero regardless of the provided value when called (ignores _val).

Move the revert to after setting MinSum so the function sets MinSum then reverts when intitalized is true (causing reversion when initialized, otherwise behaves same as original), changing observable state when revert condition differs in ordering (note: reverts undo state change).
Replace assignment to LogFile with casting to zero address (sets LogFile to address(0)) so subsequent reads differ.
Replace assignment to LogFile with assignment of msg.sender, so LogFile points to caller instead of provided address.
Replace assignment to LogFile with no-op (remove assignment) so LogFile remains unchanged after call.
Replace assignment to LogFile with assigning the provided address cast to a different type (address payable) via address(uint160) to alter stored value representation.
Replace assignment with conditional assignment that only sets LogFile when _log != address(0); otherwise leaves it unchanged.
Replace the condition that updates unlockTime so it only updates when the new computed unlock is LESS than current, inverting the original comparison.
Replace the line that increases acc.balance to instead set acc.balance equal to msg.value (overwrite previous balance).
Delete the call to LogFile.AddMessage so no log entry is created after Put.
Insert an extra immediate reset of acc.unlockTime to zero after updating it.
Move the LogFile.AddMessage call to occur before updating acc.balance.
